title: A catalog item as the Create and Edit forms take it. Written by the AI tester from BUSINESS_RULES.md; the person reviews it before the rows mean anything.

Name.description: RULE-011: required; the 50-character limit exists only in the database, so a longer name gives an error page, not a field message (suspected defect)

Description.description: RULE-011: optional; the length is not stated for Description, 200 is the tester's guess (question for the owner)

Price.description: RULE-013: 0 to 1,000,000 with at most two decimals; 19.999 is rejected, 19.50 and 0 are accepted, 1000000.01 fails the Range rule. The message says 'positive' but 0 is accepted (suspected defect)

PictureFileName.description: RULE-033: new items default to dummy.png; RULE-032: the MIME type comes from a fixed, case-sensitive extension map

CatalogBrandId.description: RULE-012: must reference an existing brand; RULE-030: the seed has 5 brands

CatalogTypeId.description: RULE-012: must reference an existing type; RULE-030: the seed has 4 types

AvailableStock.description: RULE-014: 0 to 10 million; 'The field Stock must be between 0 and 10 million.'

MaxStockThreshold.description: RULE-014; RULE-022: no rule relates it to RestockThreshold (question: should MaxStockThreshold >= RestockThreshold?)

OnReorder.description: RULE-022: never derived; a plain flag
